cancellationPolicies.label: Deposit Only rates
cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 2 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

cancellationPolicies.label: Non-refundable rates
cancellationPolicies.description: Your booking is non-refundable. If you choose to cancel your booking, or in the case of a no-show, you will still be charged the full cost of your booking.

dorms.name: 6 Bed Female Dorm
dorms.description: Female dormitory style and range in size from 2 beds upwards.  They offer female accommodation.
dorms.labelDescription:
Our 6-Bed Female Dorm with Shared Bathroom (Ages 18-40yrs Only) features:

*  Air conditioning and heating to ensure a comfortable stay
*  Comfy linen provided
*  Free lockers to stash your stuff safely 
*  Fast, free WiFi

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only
paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.

paymentProcedure.label: Non-refundable

Non-refundable
Your booking is non-refundable. The property will charge you the full amount at any time after your booking confirmation, even if you cancel or don’t show up.

privates.name: Single Private Ensuite
privates.description: Private Room with 1 single bed, sleeps one person.
privates.labelDescription:
Our Single Ensuite Rooms feature:


*  All linen, including towels
*  Airconditioning & Heating 
*  Daily housekeeping service
*  Free Wi-Fi access 
Please note: No additional amenities are included such as shampoo & room has no TV.

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 29th Oct 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 29th Oct 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
